reopened_and_root_caused_target_env_payment_contract_403: the earlier entry that recorded this blocker as closed rested on a reading served by an odoo worker that still held the pre-reload registry - the candidate release restarted the container at 2026-10-14 15:35:17Z, i.e. after that reading - so the claim did not survive. From 2026-10-14 15:44:53Z, and reproducibly again on 2026-10-14 16:21:37Z, the deployed sc_demo face answers the same exact-instance contract identity (fixture_role_finance uid 210, company 21, record 36184, action 780, menu 550, served_sha=48214f7a) with http 403. Authoritative server-side cause from the deployed log: 'Access Denied by record rules for operation: read on record ids: [14], uid: 210, model: sc.business.category'. The contract assembly reads that reference row, so the 403 was a data-space ceiling denial, not a payment.request denial. The deployed ir.rule 851 (smart_construction_core.rule_sc_data_scope_sc_business_category, global, groups=[], write_date 2026-10-14 15:29:16Z) carried the generated domain ['|', ('approval_policy_id.company_id', '=', False), '&', ('approval_policy_id.company_id', 'in', company_ids), ('approval_policy_id.company_id', 'in', user._sc_data_company_ids())]. Odoo compiles the traversal term ('approval_policy_id.company_id', '=', False) to 'approval_policy_id IN (SELECT id FROM <policy table> WHERE company_id IS NULL)', which is NULL - never true - for a row whose approval_policy_id is NULL, so the declared 'unset owner stays shared' reading silently vanished for exactly the unattributed rows. Repaired at the owning layer in this branch: scripts/verify/sc_data_scope_ceiling_generate.py now renders the unset branch of a traversed anchor as the union of 'no parent' and 'parent without an owning company', which regenerates 57 of the 143 ceiling rules (61 traversed anchors minus the 4 declaring unsetOwner: unknown, which stay strict by declaration) and changes nothing else. Verified locally by verify.sc_data_scope.ceiling.check (15 tests), verify.sc_data_scope.rule_coverage (15 + 38 tests, uncovered=[]), verify.data_space.policy.unit (12 tests) and verify.data_space.provisioning.guard (34 tests). Deployed effect is pending: the daily release upgrades smart_core only, and the ceiling XML belongs to smart_construction_core, so the repair must be released with DAILY_RUNTIME_PUBLISHED_FACE_UPGRADE_MODULES=smart_core,smart_construction_core before the readonly probe can be re-read.

open_p4_probe_has_no_per_principal_expectation_carrier: scripts/ops/dev_acceptance_release_probe.py probes a single --login per run and cannot express an allow/deny expectation per principal. The per-principal evidence for this batch therefore came from a read-only shell readback against the same governed environment (.runtime/diag/role_read_probe.py), which is a diagnostic observation, not a governed lane. open_same_source_handwritten_traversal_anchors: 13 hand-written global ir.rule company ceilings in addons/smart_construction_core/security/sc_record_rules.xml carry the identical single-traversal unset term and therefore hide rows whose parent is NULL in exactly the same way: rule_sc_workflow_workitem_tenant_business_admin_company (instance_id.company_id), rule_sc_workflow_log_tenant_business_admin_company (instance_id.company_id), rule_sc_boq_version_allowed_company, rule_sc_boq_line_allowed_company, rule_sc_boq_import_batch_allowed_company, rule_sc_boq_analysis_allowed_company, rule_sc_boq_summary_component_allowed_company, rule_sc_cost_plan_allowed_company, rule_sc_cost_plan_line_allowed_company, rule_sc_cost_plan_node_allowed_company (project_id.company_id), rule_sc_boq_analysis_norm_allowed_company, rule_sc_boq_analysis_resource_allowed_company (analysis_id.project_id.company_id), rule_sc_material_supplier_return_line_company (return_id.company_id). Read-only readback on the deployed acceptance database shows 0 rows for all 13 models, so the defect is latent there and no runtime effect has been observed; two of them (project.boq.analysis.norm.line, project.boq.analysis.resource.line) are the declared source_bounded authority for their models, which is why they cannot be left inferred. Not repaired in this batch on purpose: they are hand-written P1 security rules, a different owning layer from the P4 generator repaired here, and shipping 13 unverified security-rule edits would repeat the very failure mode this batch found. The dedicated follow-up should migrate them into the declaration/registry system and regenerate, rather than hand-patch 13 rules.
